name: WWE 2K25: Attitude Era Superstars Pack
summary:
The Attitude Era Superstars Pack adds five legendary WWE Superstars to WWE 2K25 as playable characters and includes their MyFACTION cards: Mark Henry, Billy Gunn, Road Dogg, Victoria, and D’Lo Brown.

The pack is distributed as DLC and is included as part of WWE 2K25 Season Pass, Ringside Pass, and select editions such as The Bloodline Edition and Deadman Edition.
